We have policy excerpts about rotating API key: generating new key does not automatically revoke old; both keys valid until old is explicitly revoked. Overlap window exists so you can rotate without downtime: deploy new key, confirm works, then revoke old. So answer: it allows overlap; old key remains valid until you revoke it.
